Oil flow remains limited through the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway for global oil transport. Markets in Japan, South Korea and Hong Kong were trading lower Friday. U.S. futures edged higher. On Thursday, Wall Street's benchmark S&P 500 dropped 0.6% in its fourth straight loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 0.6%, and the technology-heavy Nasdaq composite fell 0.7%.
